text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper that focuses on estimating historical and current soil organic carbon (SOC) stocks and their changes across agricultural land uses in Ireland using existing land use maps (LPIS 2000–2014). While it uses land use data as input, it does not perform any land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or future simulation. The study reconstructs past SOC changes and projects SOC trends based on fixed land use categories but does not model or predict future LULC changes under any scenario. It fails core inclusion criteria: (1) no LULC prediction component—only uses observed historical land use; (2) no implementation of ≥2 future LULC scenarios; (3) outputs are SOC stock maps, not mapped LULC projections. Additionally, it falls under the exclusion criterion "Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis," as the focus is entirely on carbon accounting, not land use dynamics or forecasting.)
